rules.title: Student-Faculty Ratio
rules.description: One full-time faculty member for every 20 students of sanctioned intake (1:15 where the programme is accredited).
rules.remediation: Recruit additional full-time faculty or reduce sanctioned intake before resubmission.

rules.title: Cadre Structure Balance
rules.description: Senior faculty must follow the statutory Professor : Associate Professor : Assistant Professor ratio of 1 : 2 : 6.
rules.remediation: Promote eligible faculty or appoint professors to restore the 1:2:6 cadre pyramid.

rules.title: Built-up Instructional Area
rules.description: Instructional space (classrooms, laboratories, tutorials) must provide at least 2.5 sq.m per student of sanctioned intake.
rules.remediation: Add instructional floor area or produce a sanctioned additional-construction plan.

rules.title: Minimum Campus Land Parcel
rules.description: A permanent campus must hold a contiguous land parcel of at least 8,000 sq.m within the approved geographic region.
rules.remediation: Submit registered land documents meeting the minimum parcel requirement.

rules.title: Doctoral Faculty Strength
rules.description: At least 40% of full-time faculty must hold a Ph.D. in the relevant discipline.
rules.remediation: Recruit doctoral faculty or enrol existing faculty in recognised Ph.D. programmes.

rules.title: Library & Learning Resources
rules.description: The central library must hold a minimum of 12 volumes per student along with prescribed journals.
rules.remediation: Procure additional titles and journal subscriptions and update the accession register.
